title: BD Admission
description: An offline-first Android app for Bangladesh university (Varsity) and Medical admission preparation, with Bangla and English question browsing, timed practice, bookmarks and local progress.
story: The first public Android preview, version 0.1.0, is distributed as a GitHub pre-release and was installed and checked on a physical Android device by the owner. This is a preview build, not a Google Play production release. The gallery uses actual runtime captures; the profile identity is anonymized and visible counters are sample local data.
highlights: University-wise Varsity and Medical question catalogues
Flash Question and Standard Exam practice modes
Offline-first local question and practice data
